summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K to disclose a securities purchase agreement with institutional accredited investors for a registered direct offering of 25 million common shares and warrants to purchase 25 million common shares at $0.40 per combined unit. The offering was conducted under an existing effective shelf registration statement via a prospectus supplement. Warrants are exercisable six months after issuance at $0.40 per share and expire six years later. This is a routine equity financing, not a special-situation event. The funds will likely support operations. There are no control changes, premiums, or strategic event triggers.
